name: setup-postgresql-firewall
description: Firewall rules for a PostgreSQL host. Rules are added first and the firewall is enabled last, guarded so it can never come up without a way back in.

tasks.name: Allow SSH from the jump host
tasks.description: Preferred when a bastion is configured: only the jump host may reach SSH

commands.cmd: ufw allow from ${jump_host_private_ip} to any port ${ssh_port} proto tcp comment 'SSH from jump host'

tasks.name: Allow SSH from anywhere
tasks.description: The fallback when no jump host is configured. Without this, enabling UFW removes the only route to the machine.

commands.cmd: ufw allow ${ssh_port}/tcp comment 'SSH (no jump host configured)'

tasks.name: Allow PostgreSQL from the allowed subnet

commands.cmd: ufw allow from ${allowed_subnet} to any port ${postgres_port} proto tcp comment 'PostgreSQL from allowed subnet'

tasks.name: Enable UFW
tasks.description: Last, and only once an SSH rule is actually present. `ufw show added` is used rather than `ufw status` because an inactive firewall reports no rules at all — checking status would have found nothing and told us nothing.
